description:
BROE auctioneers are delighted to present this two-bedroom mid terrace property to the market with the benefit of a private South West facing rear garden and is not overlooked to the front. Number 107 is brought to the market with well-appointed accommodation and spacious room proportions. The bright and spacious accommodation briefly comprises of entrance hallway, living room, kitchen / dining room, 2 spacious bedrooms and main family bathroom. To the rear is a large private South West facing garden c. (7m x 4m) and to the front is a cobble lock driveway for off-street parking. Nestled in an established area, No. 107 is a perfect location for families or first-time buyers alike. Ideally located close to a host of local amenities to include shops, schools, Clondalkin Village, the M50, N7 and the Luas is only minutes away.

Contact Craig Leap of BROE auctioneers to register your interest.
